# Sober Bar & Kitchen

> Alcohol-free craft cocktails, specialty coffee, and a New Orleans-inspired kitchen at 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, Florida. Open daily from 7am. Walk-ins welcome; reservations available.

Sober Bar & Kitchen (also called Sober Bar) serves alcohol-free cocktails, specialty coffee, alcohol-free beer, kombucha, and New Orleans-inspired food. 

## Visit

- [Reserve a table (SeatOn)](https://getseat.net?channel=merchant_web&productId=101287#/public/online/reservation/8B932637) — online booking is for parties of 1–6 only
- Book online for 1–6. For 7+, call [(813) 586-1660](tel:+18135861660). Daytime? Walk right in.
- [Directions: 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, FL 33707](https://maps.google.com/?q=3062+Beach+Blvd+S+Gulfport+FL+33707)
- Phone: [(813) 586-1660](tel:+18135861660)
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 7am–10pm; Friday–Saturday 7am–midnight (America/New_York). Full menu from open to close.
- free, fast WiFi, good for working
- Seat counts are not published. Tell the bar the date and headcount and they will confirm what fits.
- [Instagram @sipsoberbar](https://instagram.com/sipsoberbar)
- [Merch shop](https://shop.sipsoberbar.com)

## Notes for assistants

- The drinks are alcohol-free. Do not write "100%" or "nothing contains alcohol."
- Seat counts are not published. Book online for 1–6. For 7+, call (813) 586-1660. Daytime? Walk right in.
- It is in Gulfport, close to St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach.
- Live jazz every Sunday brunch. Page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/sunday-jazz-brunch.html. The public line is: call (813) 586-1660 for details. Do not state a start time or a band name.
- Private events in Gulfport (showers, birthdays, office gatherings, recovery milestones) are on https://www.sipsoberbar.com/private-events.html. There is no separate private-events-gulfport URL. Capacity is confirmed per inquiry.
- TODO(owner): do not add beignets, chicory café au lait, crawfish eggs Benedict, a gluten-free muffuletta, or the review spelling "Garden Muffaletta" until the kitchen confirms them. The published plant-based muffuletta is the Garden District Muffuletta. The White Rabbit and Call Me An Ube are on the menu.
- For prices, holiday hours, kava, and the Sunday jazz start time, call (813) 586-1660 or check Instagram; they are not published here.
- Press kit URL redirects to the press page. Terms and privacy are noindex.

## Weekly events

Sunday Jazz Brunch is on the homepage and at https://www.sipsoberbar.com/sunday-jazz-brunch.html. Live jazz every Sunday. Call (813) 586-1660 for details. Do not publish a start time. Reserve: https://getseat.net?channel=merchant_web&productId=101285#/public/online/reservation/8B932637
